title: barbadi jo aa matam
body:
Yeh Pak Nabi (saw) Kay Ghar Ka Matam Hai
Jo Sajday Main Qatal Hua Us Hadi (as) Ka Matam Hai
Asghar (as) Ko Pani Nahi Dia Masoom Ko Teer Mara Hai
Kalma Parhnay Waloon Ki Bay Dardi Ka Matam Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Nay Pak Muhammad (saw) Ki Aulad Ko Ban Main Rulaya Hai
Yeh Kofay Kay Musalmanoon Ki Bay Ahadi Ka Matam Hai
Yeh Laila (sa) Ki Khuwahish Thi Kay Akbar (as) Ko Dulha Banaoon
Jo Shadi Jangal Main Hue Us Shadi Ka Matam Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab (sa) Ki Chadar Lutnaa Sajjad (as) Kay Liye Mout Say Barh Kar Tha
Jo Chalees (40) Saal Khoon Roya Hai Us Qaidi Ka Matam Hai
Jis Nay Kofay Ki Aurat Ko Parday Ki Taleem Di Thi
Us Shehar Main Bay Chadar Us Shahzadi (sa) Ka Matam Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Azad Us Nay Qaid Reh Kay Matam Ki Bunyaad Rakhi Hai
Ek Saal Baad Zainab (sa) Ki Azadi Ka Matam Hai
